race.comment: PACKERS JOURNEY (5) bounced straight to the front from the rails draw and led until straightening before finishing fifth over 1400m at Morphettville Parks last time out. Will take catching. ATTAIN (3) was not disgraced in city class last time when sixth at Morphettville Parks but back to home course this time. Will find this much easier. Leading contender. POWER OF TIME (6) resumes from a spell of four months and is having his first outing under new trainer Niki O'Shea. Finished fourth at Murray Bridge over 900m at the opening run last time in work. Fitter for a sixth in a recent trial over 1000m at Bendigo. Can measure up at the first run for a new barn. POWERING AWAY (4) won at Donald two starts ago but was below his best at a more recent appearance, finishing ninth over 1200m at Murtoa. Finds a nice race and can atone. SUMMER NIGHT (10) will be nearing peak fitness after three runs back and looks advantaged by the low draw.
